upload.boundary: CPU payload write through upload and completed fence; readback outside timing
upload.difference: SDK padded staging versus SDL tight transfer layout; SDL default instance API request differs from the three explicit-1.1 profiles

draw.boundary: record+submit+completed fence wall time; full changing readback outside timing

pso.boundary: public creation/release calls; pipeline GPU use and full readback outside timers
pso.difference: Each API shader/pipeline setup as implemented; native creation counts, cache state and physical reclamation unverified

allocation.boundary: public creation/release calls; GPU use and full changing readback outside timers
allocation.difference: SDK general device buffer versus SDL vertex usage; neither release timing proves native allocation counts or memory reclamation
